theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.TensorSchurWeyl.snocE2_symm_apply {m : ℕ} (a : St (m + 2)) :
(snocE2 m).symm a = (Fin.init (Fin.init a), Fin.init a (Fin.last m), a (Fin.last (m + 1)))

def QOU.IwahoriHecke.TensorSchurWeyl.snocE2 (m : ℕ) :
St m × Fin 2 × Fin 2 ≃ St (m + 2)

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.TensorSchurWeyl.snocE_symm_apply {m : ℕ} (a : St (m + 1)) :
(snocE m).symm a = (Fin.init a, a (Fin.last m))
